releases.notes:
0.5.0 Finally!

*I haven't update `README.md`. Maybe tomorrow.*

## Important note about this update

This build suffers from **huge performance impact when pinging large containers** *(~ 200+ slots)*, and **poor compatibility with unrelated mods**. Recommand update to 0.5.0-beta2 instead of this build.

## TL;DR

- The ping wheel is replaced by a **spatial selection menu** with branches.
- Pings can now **carry property or item details**, shown in the HUD and in chat.
- **Inventory preview and tracking** are on by default; item markers can keep their counts updated.
- New controls include **quick double-press Danger** and an optional early-open gesture.
- Server owners get a Server Presentation editor and performance controls; Create and Sable integrations updated. FTB Teams and Simple Voice Chat integrations are removed.
- Upgrading from 0.4.x changes center-release behavior, migrates some settings, and requires updating client and server together.

---

## New ping menu

Holding the ping key now opens a spatial selection menu instead of the old wheel.

- Selecting a branch opens a submenu.
- Back is available in every submenu.
- Going back one level recenters the parent menu on your pointer.
- The selector no longer times out.
- Preferences let you adjust menu distance and size, the center dead zone, entry timing, pointer trail, menu and target opacity, and reduced motion.
- The Precise branch shows a live list of candidates from your current camera view while open and previews the captured candidate’s name.
- The Content branch includes property menus and a scrollable inventory list.
- The selector only takes over mouse input while it is open and gives clear Back and selection feedback.

## More informative pings

Pings can now carry property or item content.

- For each authorized attribute, you can choose a Ping Type—such as an intent or color—separately from the marker’s main type. (disabled by default)
- The server recaptures the actual values when the ping is created, so markers reflect the current world state rather than a client-side preview.
- Supported details include target and custom names, entity health, item identity, block state, and other authorized fields.
- Content pings show their values in the HUD and in a dedicated chat message that preserves each selected entry’s wording.

## Inventory preview and tracking

Inventory preview and tracking are available by default and need no separate opt-in.

- Selecting an inventory row creates a normal marker with an item annotation.
- The item count keeps updating for the marker’s lifetime.
- When an exact item identity cannot be represented, variants are grouped together.
- Unknown, incomplete, and unavailable states are shown explicitly.
- Inventory reads use the face of the block you were looking at.
- Options let you keep Content intent-selection menus enabled or disabled, and keep the inventory list open after the first key release.

## Input and gestures

- Quick double-press Danger: repeating a short press within a short window—without turning the view too far—creates an extra Danger ping from the first capture.
- An optional gesture shortcut can open the selector before the normal long-press threshold. It is off by default.
- Long-press compatibility mode still takes priority and disables the gestures above while active.

## Server and administration

- The settings screen adds a Server Presentation editor showing each target type’s allow and block rules and whitelist-only mode.
- Players without permission can view the authoritative server settings but cannot edit them.
- The Performance category lets server owners manage inventory preview and tracking limits, refresh cadence, and administrator notifications.

## Integrations

All integrations are optional.

releases.notes:
# Ping For It — 0.4.2 beta1 Release Notes

This release brings new config UI and several bug fixes.

## TL;DR

- Settings screen updated
- Some settings upper & lower bounds and defaults update
- several bug fixes

---

## UI

- The settings page is now better categorized to accommodate more configuration options that may be added in the future.

## Config

- Several configs now have their upper & lower bounds updated.
- Adjustedd several default configs.
- "client ping duration" option now shows its config name even when it is set to "Follow server" sentinel.

## Bug fixes

*~~Can't believe it took so long from realizing these bugs to remembering to fix them!~~*

*I must be lazy. XD*

- Fixed `Target have disappeared` chat message is hardcoded and cannot be localized.
- Multiple pings on the same target no longer make subtitles increasingly opaque.

---

Happy making your friend know about your intends! As always, [create an issue](https://github.com/a-Void-Deer/Minecraft-Ping-For-It/issues/new/choose) If you met a bug or wants a feature update.

releases.notes:
# Ping For It — 0.4.1 beta1 Release Notes

## TL;DR

- Pings now go through blank parts of create contraptions
- Improve rendering performances

---

## Create & Sable COmpatibility

- **Aim at Create contraptions more precisely** — Pings now check the contraption’s real shape instead of a big rough hitbox. You can aim through empty gaps and hit what’s actually behind them. This supports controlled, oriented/moving, carriage, gantry, and minecart-mounted contraptions on NeoForge.
  - **Your settings work inside contraptions** — Transparent-block and fluid settings apply to contraption blocks and fluids just like normal world blocks.

*For now, markers still highlight the whole contraption entity. Per-block selection in contraption are not avaliable yet.*
*Maybe after a config update. We're introducing too many keybinds!*

## Performance

- **Faster, smoother pings** — HUD markers and outlines now use a smarter entity lookup, so rendering stays lighter. On 4096 entity with 20 pinged, it provides about 35% performance boost.

*Caches are always hard to work on. Open an Issue if you met bugs!*

---

Happy Pinging! As always, Bug reports & Feature requests are welcomed!
